payload.text: RELEASE AFTER NEXT, weigh only (found 2026-11-14 at Intent's 3.3.3 cut): a remote leg's DEVBIN_GATE_CACHE (eg kovacs ~/work/intent-leg.cache, its rust-target 5.7G to 15G in a day) grows without bound, since no run clears it; kovacs's / filled (211M free of 62G) and the cut's cargo test failed. The gate cache wants a bound or a gc like WP16's artefact cache. Related: todo 217.
